Tiffany & Co. (TIF) Analysts See $0.76 EPS Posted by Marguerite Chambers 51 pm
Analysts expect Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) to report $0.76 EPS on December, 5.They anticipate $0.04 EPS change or 5.00 % from last quarter’s $0.8 EPS. TIF’s profit would be $93.04 million giving it 30.20 P/E if the $0.76 EPS is correct. After having $1.17 EPS previously, Tiffany & Co.’s analysts see -35.04 % EPS growth. The stock decreased 0.79% or $0.73 during the last trading session, reaching $91.81. About 1.65M shares traded. Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) has risen 29.29% since November 29, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 13.67% the S&P500. Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) Ratings Coverage
Among 8 analysts covering Tiffany & Co ( NYSE:TIF ), 5 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 3 Hold. Therefore 63% are positive. Tiffany & Co had 9 analyst reports since June 1, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Outperform” rating given on Wednesday, September 12 by Oppenheimer. The firm has “Hold” rating by Edward Jones given on Thursday, June 21. KeyBanc Capital Markets maintained the stock with “Overweight” rating in Wednesday, August 29 report. The stock of Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) earned “Buy” rating by Loop Capital Markets on Wednesday, November 28. The firm earned “Outperform” rating on Wednesday, August 29 by Credit Suisse. Oppenheimer maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Friday, June 1 report.
Tiffany & Co., through its subsidiaries, designs, makes, and retails jewelry and other items worldwide. The company has market cap of $11.24 billion. The Company’s jewelry products include fine and solitaire jewelry; engagement rings and wedding bands; and non-gemstone, sterling silver, and gold jewelry. It has a 25.45 P/E ratio. The firm also sells timepieces, leather goods, sterling silverware, china, crystal, stationery, fragrances, and accessories.
